name: Palm Beach Flooring & More
address: 9091 N Military Trl Ste 4, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410, United States

resenas.texto: We absolutely LOVE our new kitchen. Dan and his team took care of everything (floors, cabinets, lighting, plumbing, counters) Install was quick and clean. The “before” was outdated and depressing, can not believe it's the same kitchen. We highly recommend using Palm Beach Flooring & More! Looking forward to using them for a bathroom next.

We recently had our bathroom remodeled, and the entire experience was outstanding from start to finish. The team was professional, punctual, and paid great attention to detail throughout the project. They helped bring our vision to life and delivered a beautiful, modern bathroom that exceeded our expectations. Communication was excellent, the work area was kept clean, and the project was completed on time. I highly recommend this company to anyone looking for a bathroom remodel.

We are beyond pleased with our master bathroom remodel. Dan and his team did a fabulous job bringing our vision to life. They were on time, professional, meticulous and cleaned up after themselves every day. We'll be using them again for other projects in the future.

Dan and his team at Palm Beach Flooring & More were amazing. Dan incorporated our ideas and produced a wonderful kitchen that is easy to use and looks fantastic. The team moved doors, removed columns, installed cabinets, an island, and extra counter space all professionally and with minimal fuss. Their attention to detail and the integration of all the work was extraordinary.

Working with Dan was a pleasure and would recommend him 11/10. He was able to accommodate my needs and worked with me throughout the process. I am more than happy with the results and will be using him and his crew again if and when needed.
